LiveCopilot 2.9.0

中文

六步新手引导帮助你选择输入方式、准备本地模型，并在开始使用前测试回答服务。自定义兼容接口支持配置服务地址和模型 ID。

新增「模式与场景」设置。新手引导、模式设置与实时回答触发页共用 Jev Mode 开关卡片，实时触发页还可查看 Laya 状态和调整灵敏度。

设置页现在明确区分知识库索引模型与回答模型。推荐在本机使用 BGE-M3 检索资料，无需 OpenAI Key。

知识库检索会复用已读取的向量。同一场监听中更换文档后，下一次提问即可使用更新后的资料。

English

Six-step onboarding guides you through audio inputs, local models and testing your answer service. Custom compatible endpoints support a configurable URL and model ID.

Conversation modes and tools now have their own settings page. Jev Mode uses the same switch card across onboarding and settings, with Laya status and sensitivity available under real-time triggers.

Knowledge indexing and answer generation are clearly identified in settings. The recommended local BGE-M3 index runs without an OpenAI API key.

Knowledge retrieval reuses vectors in memory and picks up document changes during an ongoing listening session.

# LiveCopilot 2.8.0

## 中文

- 改善远程会议中的说话人归属，减少扬声器回声被识别成我方发言及错误打断回答。

- 保留对方插话前已识别的我方内容，改善插话时句首被截断的问题。

- 改善麦克风设备变化后的恢复与本地识别进程异常处理。

- 个性化额外提示词新增保存状态与按钮，自定义格式优先于默认回答风格。

- 精简自动回答状态文案，减少悬浮窗重复信息；默认开启回答区自动伸缩，关闭自动贴边和共享隐藏。

- 专业术语识别标记为 Beta，移到模型管理下方。热词增强效果仍因词汇与发音而异，不保证准确识别。

已有配置保留。应用与安装包使用 Developer ID 签名并通过 Apple 公证。支持 Apple Silicon 与 Intel Mac。

## English

- Improved speaker attribution in remote meetings, reducing speaker echo appearing as your speech and incorrectly interrupting answers.

- Preserved recognized speech when the other participant interrupts and improved clipped phrase beginnings.

- Improved microphone recovery after device changes and handling of local recognition worker failures.

- Added explicit saving for custom answer instructions; custom formatting takes priority over default answer style.

- Simplified answer status messages and removed repeated overlay information. Automatic answer-area sizing defaults on; edge hiding and capture exclusion default off.

- Marked terminology enhancement as Beta and moved it below model management. Recognition improvements remain dependent on vocabulary and pronunciation.

Existing settings are preserved. Developer ID signed and Apple notarized, for Apple Silicon and Intel Macs.

LiveCopilot 2.7

# LiveCopilot 2.7

- 转写区支持三行折叠，原文与译文统一对齐；折叠时自动跟随最新内容。
- 新增转写翻译及目标语言选择，支持稳定临时转写和流式译文。
- Zipformer 英文大小写整理，改善英文转写可读性。
- 自由知识、混合知识、仅知识库三种回答模式；混合模式对无关问题使用通用知识。
- 自动回答显示具体等待或拦截原因，诊断包含阶段计数与最近事件。
- 修复部分因我方语音被抑制的问题，在新转写事件到达后无法重新判断的情况；保留防抢答与旧事件去重。
- 新增本地诊断摘要和私下反馈 ZIP，可选择包含原始崩溃报告；不会自动上传。
- 改善音频故障记录、反馈输入框与导出流程，保留已有设置、模型、凭证和历史。

转写翻译使用已配置的回答服务，可能产生服务费用。诊断不保证自动定位所有故障；请附发生时间和复现步骤。Laya 模型权重未更新。

## English

- Compact three-line transcripts with consistent original/translation alignment.
- Optional streaming transcript translation and Zipformer English casing cleanup.
- General, mixed and knowledge-base-only answer modes, with improved mixed-mode instructions.
- Explicit automatic-answer gate status, diagnostic counters and bounded event history.
- Allow a fresh final transcript event to retry a question previously suppressed by own speech while preserving stale-event and duplicate protection.
- Local diagnostic summaries and private support ZIP export, optional raw crash reports, and clearer export controls. Nothing is uploaded automatically.
- Existing settings, credentials, models and history are preserved. Translation may incur configured provider charges; Laya model weights are unchanged.
